title: TeaAgent Audit Chain Entry (envelope)
description: Strict physical envelope for a single line in a chained audit JSONL log as written by AuditLogger. Contains the logical event fields (event_id, event_type, run_id, created_at, payload) plus the hash-chain integrity fields (prev_hash, hash, chain_hmac). The optional seq and level fields are reserved for future use. additionalProperties is false so any unexpected field is rejected.

level.description: Optional audit tier level. Not always present on disk.

seq.description: Optional monotonic sequence number. Reserved for future use; not currently written by AuditLogger.
